blocNotes: Lines covered: the HS headings listed (rice, sweetened waters and other non-alcoholic drinks, beer, wine, spirits of 2208.20/.30/.40/.60, cigarettes, petrol, distillate fuel, medicaments, cotton T-shirts, smartphones, cars of 1 500-3 000 cm3); any other code is grade C (otherBp -1). A code coarser than the 8-digit spirit lines (e.g. 2208.30) is grade C (the two container sizes differ).
Specific duties per litre of product (c/li) are read as money per canonical unit (litre); the amounts are cents of the tariff currency.
An imported line with no origin pays the General rate (the model's convention, mfnIfOriginUnknown); a SACU origin pays nothing (art. 18); EU/UK and EFTA origins pay their column where it is lower.
The customs value is the price before VAT and duty; where an excise is also inside the price the line should give customsValue (otherwise the value is overstated by the excise).
